visible_text: 34. 設 f(x) 為二次函數。若 y = f(x) 的圖像的頂點的坐標為 (3, -4)，則下列何者必為正確？ A. 方程 f(x)=0 的根均為整數。 B. 方程 f(x)-3=0 的根均為有理數。 C. 方程 f(x)+4=0 的根均為實數。 D. 方程 f(x)+5=0 的根均為非實數。
reasoning: Because the vertex form of the quadratic is f(x)=a(x-3)^2-4 with a≠0. Then f(x)+4 = a(x-3)^2, so the equation f(x)+4=0 becomes a(x-3)^2=0, which yields the double real root x=3. Hence statement C is always true regardless of the sign or magnitude of a, while the other statements depend on the value of a and are not guaranteed.
